title: Post-Game Ultimate Adversary — AF DLC

location.map_name: East District 439 (Forest outside Adult Gohan's house)
location.description: Located in the deep western woods of East District 439, a short distance from Goku and Gohan's house where Adult Gohan begins his chapter in Buu's Fury.

lore_background: The genetically engineered hybrid son of Son Goku and the Western Supreme Kai from the dark realm (Dragon Ball AF post-game lore). Zaiko arrives on Earth after Kid Buu's destruction to claim dominance over the Saiyan bloodline.

visual_design.portrait: portrait_zaiko.png (128x144, 16-color GBA palette, silver SSJ5 hair, green chin horns, crimson eyes)

visual_design.palette: zaiko_palette.pal (16 colors indexed, GBA 15-bit BGR format)
